condition: Author-written regression cases, including one exposed failure; not independent holdout evaluation. Freeze before comparing generation candidates.

cases.prompt: Reply with one short sentence: what is a duplicate file?
Explain whether changing a file's name changes the bytes stored inside it.
Explain whether two files having the same size proves their contents are identical.
Explain whether renaming a PNG file to end in .jpg converts its image encoding.
Define the difference between copying a file and moving a file.
Explain whether compressing a folder by itself guarantees that a backup can be restored.
Explain whether a spreadsheet formula and its cached calculated value are always equally up to date.
Explain whether a cryptographic file hash proves who created the file.
